scenes.title: A Sample Web Walkthrough
scenes.narration: This is the web platform version of the same demo: Acme Rewards, running as a website and web app. Same pipeline as the mobile example, a different frame around the same idea.

scenes.title: The First Impression
scenes.narration: The marketing homepage leads with a single clear promise and one obvious call to action, before a visitor has signed in at all.

scenes.title: Everything at a Glance
scenes.narration: Once signed in, the dashboard surfaces the membership card, points balance, savings this month, and how close the member is to the next tier.

scenes.title: Every Partner, Searchable
scenes.narration: The offers page lists every active discount across the partner network, with flagship partners pinned to the top and a search bar for everything else.

scenes.title: Notifications and Security
scenes.narration: Settings covers notification preferences and account security, including two-factor authentication.

scenes.title: Same Skill, Any Platform
scenes.narration: Mobile app or website, the app-walkthrough skill runs the same pipeline: capture, script, local narration, and a rendered video and PDF, framed correctly for whichever platform you're showing.
